lines.text: Samson spends the night with a prostitute in Gaza, then rises at midnight and carries the city gate to a mountain near Hebron.
Samson falls in love with Delilah from the Valley of Sorek, and the Philistine lords offer her eleven hundred shekels of silver each.
Samson tells Delilah that seven fresh bowstrings will make him weak, but he snaps the new ropes when she ties him.

wrong_details.wrong: he snaps the new ropes when she ties him
wrong_details.true: he snaps the bowstrings when she ties him

lines.text: Delilah ties him with new ropes, then weaves his seven braids into a loom, and Samson pulls out the pin each time.
Delilah presses Samson every week until he reveals his hair has never been cut, and the Philistines take him to Gaza and grind him in the temple.
